name: plant-keeper
shortDescription: Every plant on a card with a water ring that drains until you tap.
description: A page of your houseplants, one card each. Each card's soil ring drains over that plant's watering interval and turns amber, then red, as the day comes; the plant's leaves droop once it is overdue. Tap Watered and a droplet falls into the pot, the ring fills, and the leaves perk back up. The header counts how many plants are thirsty today, room tabs group the cards, and a fourteen-day strip shows which plants need water on each day ahead. Each plant's sheet holds its light, your notes, and its water log, and you can log a watering on another day. Waterings stay in the browser, with Export and Import to move them. Light and dark themes.
